_comment: Phase 2.95 Item 4 — revised from Phase 2.95 initial version (k=26 → k=13).
_declaration_note: This family was declared after seeing p-values from the Phase 2.75 run (commit be86e77). It was NOT declared blind. However, the family is declared here BEFORE the Phase 2.95 overnight rerun, and no comparison is added or removed based on the new results. The Holm-Bonferroni correction is applied at the moment of first report from Phase 2.95 results only.
primary_test_selection_rule: McNemar for binary exact-match outcomes; Wilcoxon signed-rank for continuous metrics. One primary test per comparison enters the Holm family. The second test is reported as a robustness check only and does NOT enter the family.
